method: Direct visual inspection of rendered F4, F4b and exclusion-bias PNGs; six contact sheets covering every fixed-seed sample/showcase layout. Numerical and geometric validity are separate independent checks.
observations: All 33 layouts have readable slot labels, legends and geometry; no clipping or blank plot observed.
The 18 m2 H3 showcase visibly changes bed/table states under S2; other showcases retain actual small or zero gains.
Negative conditional area-saving estimates and unsupported intervals are retained. Wide intervals and censoring limit interpretation.
limits: Contact sheets check rendered presentation; they do not establish architectural feasibility beyond the implemented validator.
